messages:
Elena: Noticed discrepancy in billing and observability when clients cancel midstream. Need a clear handoff + termination signal at gateway so upstreams stop work and analytics don't double-count.
Tom: Can we standardize a single small final event that is always emitted by the gateway? trailers for h2/h3, final JSON chunk for http/1.1. That would be our canonical source of truth for termination.
Raj: Agree. Also add an attempt id header so retries are correlated: `x-rw-original-id` + `x-rw-attempt`. Upstream can mark frames `speculative` until winner ack.
Marta: What about hedging? If we fan-out, we need a quick way to revoke non-winning upstreams. Control plane RPC feels best (fast, internal). Data-plane trailers still for public visibility.
Elena: Yes. Sequence: gateway issues handoff token on connect, fanout upstreams with token=active/standby, winner decided -> control-plane revoke to standbys + terminal-event to client with `stream_status`.
Tom: Token semantics: short TTL, HMAC-signed, includes attempt number. Header: `x-rw-handoff`. If upstream ignores revoke, gateway credits billing correctly anyway.
Raj: For http/1.1 we can't rely on trailers. Propose small final chunk: `{"stream_status":"client_cancel","attempt":2,"winner":true}`. Keep it compact.
Marta: Memory: avoid buffering entire responses to emit a trailer. We just append a tiny terminal chunk and flush; runtime already supports h2/h3 trailers; implement minimal terminal chunk for http/1.1.
Elena: Retries: new attempt gets new span-id but same trace-id. Link via `x-rw-parent-span` so traces show lineage. Also add `attempt_count` to telemetry events.
Tom: Prefetch window: upstreams may precompute frames. Add `x-rw-prefetch-window` and make it adaptive per-route. Default 1, can increase when cancellation rate low.
Raj: Observability events: `handoff_issued`, `handoff_revoked`, `handoff_winner`, `terminal_emitted`, plus metrics for `speculative_frames` and `prefetch_used`. Include hashed tenant id and attempt_count.
Marta: Security: never use these headers for auth. Sign tokens, rotate signing keys, and strip PII from telemetry. Also add WAF allowlist entries for new headers in staging.
Elena: Backcompat: feature-flag `handoff-token-enabled` per-tenant. If upstream lacks support, gateway falls back to socket-close and treats upstream output as speculative.
Tom: Billing: gateway should only mark frames billable once winner ack received. Upstreams can tag frames as `speculative=true` by default.
Raj: Edge case: long-lived streams need renewals. Token store in gateway should renew on heartbeat and keep lease for configurable TTL; if evicted, issue revoke.
Marta: Devops note: infra-bot, please add `x-rw-handoff`, `x-rw-prefetch-window`, `x-rw-trace-id`, `x-rw-attempt` to staging WAF allowlist and schedule rollout window.
infra-bot: Acked: headers added to staging allowlist. Rollout scheduled Thu 02:00 UTC.
Elena: Action items: 1) RFC with sequence diagrams (I'll draft) 2) gateway: handoff token + terminal-chunk impl 3) control-plane revoke RPC (Raj to prototype) 4) telemetry + billing changes (Marta) 5) canary behind feature flag.
Tom: I'll add sample payloads for h2 trailers and http/1.1 final chunk in the RFC.
Raj: Prototyping token store now. Will include HMAC scheme and TTL knobs.
Marta: I'll coordinate with analytics and billing for dedupe rules.
Elena: Thanks all. Keep the initial defaults conservative (token_ttl=200ms, prefetch_window=1). Ping when RFC is up. :thumbsup:
